newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland plans $500 mln intl bond issue cap in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Poland plans $500 mln intl bond issue cap in 1998.

text.p: Finance Minister Marek Belka, working on the next year's budget draft, said on Friday his ministry planned to set next year's limit for international bond issues at $500 million.
"The level (for the 1998 international bond issue) is $500 million," Belka told a news conference.
This year's budget limit for international borrowings was also set at $500 million and the government used up $400 million of for last week's yankee bond issue.
